# wasm3

The WebAssembly interpreter that hosts engines (DESIGN 5.11) in C and C++
applications generated by Clarity: the core of [wasm3](https://github.com/wasm3/wasm3)
v0.5.0, `source/*.c` and `source/*.h` as released, MIT (see LICENSE). Left
out: its WASI, libc and tracer bindings (`m3_api_*`) and extensions, since an
engine imports only Clarity's own services. A generated application gets these files only when it
declares an engine.

Two changes, each marked `Clarity:`:

- `m3_compile.c`: `call_indirect` reads its table index as a full LEB number,
  as compilers with reference types (Rust since 1.82, recent clang) write it,
  instead of one byte.
- `m3_core.c`, `m3_exec.h` and `wasm3.h`: `m3_Yield` asks `m3_YieldHook` when
  the host sets it, and every turn of a loop yields too (not only every
  call), so the host can stop a call that runs past its time limit.
